products.name: Application Management Current-State Assessment & Modernization Roadmap (Microsoft Endpoint / Intune) — Commercial
products.short_description: Stop guessing where your app management stands. Score nine dimensions against an evidence-based maturity model, turn the gaps into a risk-rated findings register, and get a sequenced 30/60/90-day modernization roadmap — all read-only, self-guided, and a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Know exactly where your application management stands — and what to fix first

Almost every organization's app estate in Intune grew rather than was designed. Apps arrived one at a time, were packaged by whoever was free, assigned to whichever group was handy, and never retired. The result is familiar and expensive: nobody can say how many apps are really deployed, install failures are tolerated as background noise, three versions of the same product run at once, and every conversation about “modernizing app management” stalls because there is no agreed picture of where things stand. This package is the front-door engagement that fixes that — it scores your current state, rates the risks, and hands you a sequenced roadmap that tells you which deeper work to fund, in what order, and why.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested assessment method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by five ready-to-run, read-only PowerShell scripts that read your tenant directly.

  • Simpler — eight ordered phases with full navigation paths; every artifact you produce is named (Scoring Sheet, Findings Register, Roadmap One-Pager) and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable maturity assessment from a consultancy runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every re-assessment.
  • Tested — a repeatable, evidence-based method with explicit pass/fail gates that prove the assessment is read-only, objective, and defensible.

What makes this objective, not just another opinion survey

The core is the APPASMT Maturity Model — 9 Dimensions x 5 Levels: Governance & Ownership, Packaging Standards, Deployment & Rings, Patching & Version Currency, Security & Application Control, Lifecycle & Retirement, Monitoring & Reporting, Support Model, and Tooling & Migration Debt. Every level has an observable evidence table — you cannot award a score without producing the artifact or the tenant data that justifies it. Interviews describe intent; the scripts show reality; where they disagree, that gap becomes your most valuable finding.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the 9x5 maturity model, the discovery method, and the Assess→Design→Configure→Pilot→Validate→Expand model this assessment feeds.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement, built around least-privilege read-only access (Intune Read Only Operator + Graph .Read.All scopes).
  • Implementation Guide — the assessment run as eight ordered phases: charter, access, artifacts, interviews, technical collection, evidence-based scoring against all nine evidence tables, findings with business impact + risk rating, and the roadmap & executive readout — with pass/fail gates.
  • 5 read-only PowerShell scripts — app estate inventory & classification, assignment sprawl & conflict analysis, install-failure & version-drift baseline, unmanaged/sideloaded app detection, and a maturity-evidence aggregator that emits a scored data pack — Microsoft Graph read scopes only; nothing writes to the tenant.
  • Reusable templates — scoring sheet, findings register, risk matrix, roadmap one-pager, and executive readout, plus Testing/validation gates and Best Practices.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each engagement feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the model on every re-assessment; the movement in your scores across a second run is the proof the investment worked.

The bottom line

A defensible, evidence-based answer to “how good is our application management, and what do we fix first?” — a 1–5 score across nine dimensions, a risk-rated findings register, and a three-wave modernization roadmap (Quick Wins → Foundational → Strategic) plotted on effort vs impact with dependencies mapped and a 30/60/90 + 12-month view.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited assessments — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click assessment: solution overview, requirements, eight-phase implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run, read-only scripts:
    • APPASMT-Estate-Inventory.ps1 — inventory & classify the Intune app estate by type, publisher, assignment intent (read-only)
    • APPASMT-Assignment-Analysis.ps1 — find assignment sprawl, conflicts, All-Devices targeting, orphaned assignments (read-only)
    • APPASMT-Install-Health.ps1 — install-failure and version-drift baseline per app (read-only)
    • APPASMT-Unmanaged-Detection.ps1 — detect unmanaged / sideloaded software on managed devices (read-only)
    • APPASMT-Maturity-Evidence.ps1 — aggregate the evidence into a scored data pack with a suggested level per dimension (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
